verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single-file local LLM runtime that bundles model weights, an inference engine and a server. It has no concept of user automations or workflows, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
